thread.topic: AFK Protection needs to be removed

posts.bodyHtml:
It's really nice that you have a suggestion about this @Luckiris cause I know myself that many people are abusing it. It says in the rules now that you can't do it but yeah people still do it...


There is tho a "knife dozer" that will move you to spec after around 30-50 seconds not really sure after how long but it's still there. I guess you want the timer of it to be less and I think that can be done but I'm not the one who makes the shots here. Either way thanks alot for the info and the nice suggestion!

I don't think that the afk protection should be removed as some people abuse it, that's true but in the rules it says
"*NEW* - It is prohibited to abuse the AFK protection (Fake AFK applies as well)"
So there is admin job to deal with it if someone abuses and you can call-admin for this as well so I don't see the point of removing it.

In my opinion, switching this or combining this with the spec-move after a certain period of time is better. Admins aren't always guaranteed to be online and the spec-move can resolve issues with stamm farming as well.


~Doo Doo
